column1: # Interaction rows: a pose plus the keys/console commands that make the retail engine act.
# Same format as shots.tsv; the harness applies `-Keys` and `-ConsoleCommands` to every row it runs.
# switch_use: the level-1 cantina door switch. Things 56/57 are linked to cog 11 (`00_doorswitch.cog`,
# link 1) at (-4.75,-3.75,-1.10)/(-4.45,-3.75,-1.10). The warp at eye z -1.09 is coords-verified:
# facing the switch (yaw 135 = direction (-0.707,-0.707)). Round 192 swept the use bindings from this
# pose -- `9`, ENTER, E, SPACE, U and MOUSEMIDDLE (the profile's ACTIVATE, DirectInput 0x102) -- and cog
# 11 stayed `doorstatus 0` for every one, so the row is kept as the reproducible pose for the next probe.
